days.title: Heart of the Lakes and Marshes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Princenhof
stops.detail: In the middle of the national park lies the so-called Princenhof, an area consisting of several small lakes, bays and islands.

stops.name: Schwingrasen
stops.detail: From an ecological point of view, the intermediate stages of this process are particularly interesting, above all the so-called quaking bog, a substrate that looks like solid ground at first glance but is still washed out underneath and "vibrates" with every step.

stops.name: blauwgraslanden
stops.detail: Another special form of vegetation are the so-called blue grasslands.

days.title: Traces of Peat Harvesting
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: petgaten
stops.detail: This created approximately 1.5-meter-deep, elongated bodies of water, the so-called petgaten.

stops.name: legakkers
stops.detail: Between these were narrow strips of unexcavated, dry land on which the cut peat was laid out to dry, the so-called legakkers.
